voice_profile.rule: Never auto-approve a generated or substituted voice.

visual_rules: Preserve the canonical facial proportions and recognizable identity from validated references.
Natural skin texture and age-appropriate appearance.
No beauty-filter redesign or generic model substitution.
acting_rules: Use restrained natural acting and micro-expressions.
Prefer eye movement, breathing, posture and small facial reactions over exaggerated gestures.
Keep emotional continuity between adjacent shots.
